summary: Iter17 Admin 2FA (TOTP) fully verified — BACKEND 14/14 GREEN and FRONTEND end-to-end GREEN. Backend: /admin/2fa/status returns enabled:false on a fresh admin; /setup returns 32-char base32 secret + data:image/png;base64 QR + otpauth:// URI + issuer 'AvtoResurs Admin' and is idempotent (same pending secret on second call); /verify-setup rejects wrong code with 400 and accepts a fresh pyotp.TOTP(secret).now() returning {ok:true, mfa_token:'<base64url>.<sha256-hex>'}; after enablement /admin/clients?limit=1 WITHOUT X-Admin-MFA-Token returns 401 with body containing 'двухфакторной' — WITH the header it returns 200; /admin/2fa/login rejects wrong code 401 and a fresh TOTP returns {mfa_token, expires_in:3600}; /admin/2fa/disable with the correct TOTP flips status back to enabled:false. Customer (client@buyanywhere.com) hitting /admin/2fa/setup gets 403. The /admin/2fa/status endpoint correctly does NOT require X-Admin-MFA-Token (verified separately). FRONTEND: logged in as admin via JWT-in-localStorage trick, /auto/admin shows 15 tabs ending with 'Безопасность' (data-testid=admin-tab-security). Clicking it renders admin-2fa-section + admin-2fa-start-btn. Pressing the start button shows admin-2fa-setup with admin-2fa-qr image, admin-2fa-secret text (32 chars) and admin-2fa-verify-input/btn. Submitting a TOTP computed from the visible secret flipped admin-2fa-status text to '2FA включена'. After clearing localStorage.admin_mfa_token + reload, AdminMfaGate (data-testid=admin-mfa-gate) intercepts /auto/admin and admin-tab-vehicles is NOT present until a correct TOTP is submitted via admin-mfa-code-input/admin-mfa-submit. The window.prompt-driven 'Отключить 2FA' round-trips state back to '2FA отключена'. REGRESSION GREEN — /api/auto/vehicles total ≥ 1000 (iter15 intact) and /api/auto/payment-terms still returns the tiered v2026.06.25.2 contract (iter16 intact). Cleanup: admin@buyanywhere.com left with auto_totp_enabled:false and no pending secret (verified post-test).
critical_code_review_comments: services/auto_admin_2fa.py — disable() requires the current TOTP code, which is correct, but does NOT additionally require the active MFA token. If an attacker has briefly obtained a JWT (e.g. via XSS) they could disable 2FA with just one OTP. Consider gating /admin/2fa/disable behind require_admin (which already demands X-Admin-MFA-Token when 2FA is on) instead of require_user. Currently it sits on require_user → admin-only check, bypassing the MFA gate.

services/auto_admin_2fa.py:23-27 — _MFA_SECRET falls back to the hardcoded string 'buyanywhere-admin-mfa-2026' if neither ADMIN_MFA_SECRET nor JWT_SECRET is set. In a fresh deploy without env wiring this would let anyone forge MFA tokens. Recommend raising on startup if no secret is configured in production.

AdminMfaGate.jsx checkGate() probes /admin/clients?limit=1 to test the cached MFA token — fine but couples the gate to a specific endpoint. If /admin/clients ever becomes >1s, the gate adds visible latency to every admin pageload. Consider a dedicated /admin/2fa/verify-token endpoint or a HEAD probe.

AdminMfaGate.jsx Admin2FASection.disable2fa() uses window.prompt — not testable without dialog handler and breaks on mobile browsers that suppress prompts. Replace with the same inline 6-digit input pattern used in the gate.

routes/auto/_deps.py require_admin reads auto_totp_enabled from the user document fetched inside require_user. If an admin enables 2FA in one tab and a second tab's user doc is cached anywhere, the gate could miss it — currently mongo find is fresh per request so OK, but worth a code comment to prevent future caching regressions.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter17 2FA contract is GREEN end-to-end. (1) Five backend endpoints under /api/auto/admin/2fa/* work as specified: status (no MFA), setup (idempotent pending secret + QR), verify-setup (400 wrong / 200 + mfa_token correct), login (401 wrong / 200 fresh mfa_token), disable (200 + status reset). (2) require_admin correctly demands X-Admin-MFA-Token whenever the admin's auto_totp_enabled=true; without it returns 401 with 'двухфакторной' in detail. (3) Frontend AdminMfaGate intercepts /auto/admin and hides all admin-tab-* until the OTP is submitted; the autoApi axios interceptor automatically injects the cached token on every /admin/* request. (4) The Admin2FASection setup card exposes admin-2fa-qr/secret/verify-input/verify-btn with all the right testids, and the disable button uses window.prompt() — testers must register a page.once('dialog', d=>d.accept(code)) handler. (5) Regressions intact: catalog total≥1000 (iter15), /api/auto/payment-terms tier1=20%/tier2=30%/base=1000 (iter16). MINOR codebase concern (NOT a blocker): /admin/2fa/disable sits on require_user (not require_admin) so it bypasses its own MFA gate — see critical_code_review_comments for full list.
